quotes.speaker: Koa Peat
quotes.summary_phrase: Koa Peat on community involvement and giving back
quotes.excerpt: Me and my family, it's been something we've done since I was a young kid.
quotes.quote: I feel like I've made a difference already. Me and my family, it's been something we've done since I was a young kid, is give back to the community. It's something I'm big on, especially being from here. Even if I wasn't from here, I'd still be giving back to the community. It's something that brings me joy to my heart.
